description: Source code for NGAP connection handling in a 5G network component, including classes for managing N2 interface message forwarding, connection lifecycle, and asynchronous TNL removal.

classes.name: n2_rx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to forward NGAP Rx PDUs from N2 GW to CU-CP NGAP, signals connection loss on destruction.

classes.name: n2_tx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to forward NGAP PDUs to N2 GW, manages lifetime of TNL connection, signals disconnection.

classes.name: ngap_connection_handler
classes.description: Handles NGAP connection lifecycle, including establishing, losing, and removing N2 TNL associations.

methods.name: connect_to_amf
methods.description: Establishes connection to AMF, creates NGAP Rx and Tx notifiers, returns a Tx notifier.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss
methods.description: Handles disconnection event, dispatches cleanup to NGAP executor.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss_impl
methods.description: Performs actual cleanup of connection state and signals disconnection.

methods.name: handle_tnl_association_removal
methods.description: Asynchronously removes N2 TNL association, waits for disconnection.
